operators/price_bio:
John Price has spent most of his career with the 22nd Special Air Service Regiment fighting in the shadows. He is a veteran of military operations in nearly every conflict-prone corner of the world. He is a man of few words, but his words always count. He knows the rules, reads from the back of the book and is willing to break ranks and violate orders to get the job done.

Sometimes unpredictable and unrestrained, John Price has a golden rule all his own: “Cut heads off snakes. No matter who, no matter where…” Specializing in unconventional warfare, the Captain is a target focused war fighter who deploys a cut to the chase lethality.

In 2019, with the help of CIA Station Chief Kate Laswell and the oversight of General Shepherd- under the Five Eyes Alliance, Captain Price stood up a new unit he called Task Force 141. This covert Joint Operations squadron is on call to mobilize anywhere in the world with immediate readiness.

operators/reyes_bio:
Reyes grew up in northwestern Alberta, spending most of his time hunting and trapping in the cragged terrain of the Caribou mountains. He often missed school, instead preferring an education from those he considers life’s greatest teachers: history and experience.

An avid history buff, Reyes regaled himself with the military tactics and prowess of Caesar, Napoleon, Shingen, and Barca, learning how small teams with strong tactics could conquer armies.

Reyes joined the military early, lying about his age and forging signatures to get accepted. He was accepted to the Canadian Special Operations Regiment (CSOR), though was rolled back due to locking horns with his instructors over proper tactics.

After multiple tours in the Al Mazrah & Urzikstan region, Reyes set his sights on small-unit, Tier-1 teams. He left CSOR in 2020, and, officially, that’s where his military career ends. However, Reyes now operates with multi-national “deniable forces”, fighting on the frontlines of wars the world will never know.

operators/ronin_bio:
An ex-Special Forces officer, Daniel Shinoda’s skills in unconventional warfare were highly sought after during the Verdansk conflict. In 2019, the “one-man-army” volunteered for ARMISTICE, a multi-national force that opposed emerging threats in the region. He believed this force would restore balance to the war-ravaged lands and was the master he could serve. Instead, he saw it descend into chaos.

After the fall of Armistice, different factions fought over the remnants of territory, equipment, and ordnance. It wasn’t long before their wars were spilling into neighboring areas such as Urzikstan/Al-Mazrah. As a masterless mercenary, Ronin took it upon himself, using his skills in reconnaissance and sabotage, to maintain balance between these factions.

In this way, Ronin has finally found the master he can serve, one that cannot be corrupted: balance, itself.

operators/roze_bio:
Rozlin “Roze” Helms grew up in the Colorado mountains and became one of the first women ever to graduate from the Army Ranger School. Proficient in small-unit tactics and close combat engagements, Roze had found her profession, or so she thought. It wasn’t long before she and the military machine cut ties, leaving a well-trained warrior with few choices.

Linking up with a former colleague, Roze joined The Jackals, a well-funded, non-governmental organization (NGO) focused on eliminating Al-Qatala influence in the Pan-African region. In 2020, a new opportunity came knocking at her door. It was Philip Graves, Commander of Shadow Company. The contract offered was simple: help restore order in Verdansk.

Unseen forces had different plans for Verdansk, however, and after it fell in the wake of Zakhaev’s death, Shadow Company faced its own set of challenges. Roze ended her contract in early 2022 and aligned with the KorTac group. Her skills keep her a highly sought-after operator in a post-asymmetric warfare world.

The Scottish born, Johnny “Soap” MacTavish, is a fearless, self assured and instinctive hard-charger. He remains the youngest candidate to pass SAS selection in Royal Army history. He earned the nickname “Soap” for cleaning house with remarkable speed and accuracy in room clearance techniques and urban warfare tactics. He is competitive, daring and always looking for a win.

Soap is a trained sniper and demolitions expert, often operating in isolation and under pressure, performing critically timed activities in support of clandestine missions. He is a risk taker, a fierce competitor and a fighter in every sense of the word.

Soap has spent the last seven years carrying out both covert and overt operations around the world. In 2019, he was chosen to be part of Captain Price’s newly formed elite special operations unit known as Task Force 141.

operators/stiletto_bio:
Headstrong and vindictive, STILETTO became a cop for one reason – revenge. Already marked with the scar that splits her face, her fellow officers at the Gendarmerie never learned how she came to acquire it, or her intimate knowledge of Italy’s organized crime network, the CAMORRA. Stiletto told them only that her war was a personal one. As a member of the Carabinieri’s Anti-Mafia/Anti-Drug Task Forces, Stiletto earned a reputation as a fearless door-kicker more than willing to get her hands dirty.

As her personal vendetta against the Camorra – in particular, heroin traffickers – grew across the boot of Italy, it eventually pulled her into the GLOBAL WAR ON DRUGS. Realizing that she needed to attack her country’s drug problem at its source – its supply – Stiletto volunteered to train foreign police forces in IRAQ, AFGHANISTAN, and LAS ALMAS.

An expert in urban-warfare, Stiletto is skilled in CQC and surgical with her preferred weapon of choice – a stiletto switchblade.

El Sin Nombre (Valeria Garza) is the elusive leader of a powerful international trafficking organization operating out of Mexico known as the Las Almas cartel. Under Valeria’s leadership, Las Almas has become notorious for their expertise in smuggling, funneling tons of narcotics into the US and Europe each year, with influence stretching over 6 continents. She has expanded the cartel’s reach to operate protective “services”, assassinations, extortion and for-profit kidnappings, operating smuggling and trafficking lanes across the globe.

Valeria has focused on forging unholy alliances with unlikely partners all over the world, not only to advance her business, but aligning herself with crime and terror syndicates gives her organization leverage and intelligence on a worldwide scale.

operators/zero_bio:
SAMI ZAKARIA, the youngest child of a wealthy Egyptian family, lived a charmed life. He spent his days at country clubs and his evenings at nightclubs. He lived only for the moment, and himself. Then one night, a terrorist attack shattered his privileged world. While he was lucky enough to survive the blast, his sisters were not. Sami was left wallowing in guilt, until his uncle – a colonel in the EGYPTIAN ARMED FORCES – suggested that Sami go out and do something about the pain he felt. 

Taking his uncle’s advice, Sami enlisted in the EGYPTIAN ARMED FORCES. There, he sought to atone for his guilt by dedicating himself to protecting others. He was so driven by this pursuit that he was invited to join Egypt’s premier fighting force, the EL- SA’KA FORCES, where he was assigned to TASK FORCE 777, the counter-terrorism unit.

A serious and self-less man, “Zero” earned his nickname for the recalibration of his values, and the regard he has for his own life.

operators/zeus_bio:
ZOSAR KALU was born in Edo State, in the South-Niger-Delta, to a middle-class family. The eldest of three children, he helped raise his younger siblings, while his parents pursued dreams of high-office. His younger brother, born with Dysarthria (a speech disorder), would pronounce his name “Zeus”. His family found this fitting and adopted it.

After graduating university, Zeus served in the National Youth Service Corps. Stationed in Makurdi, he quickly became enthralled with a Special Forces Battalion, seeing them work with Western militaries to combat Al-Qatala. Because of this, his service year became a service career.

As Zeus rose through the ranks in Special Forces, so did his family in the political world. During the election for Minister of Justice, a local AQ cell attacked the voter center, killing over 50 people- his family included. Now the last of his name, Zeus established the “Thunder” Corps, a counter-terrorism group dedicated to hunting AQ wherever they hide and bringing them to justice.

operators/zimo_bio:
Zhìqiáng Huáng (20s) was born to be a soldier. Raised as a member of the working class in the industrial city of Tiānjīn, Zhìqiáng followed the footsteps of his grandmother, who fought in the trenches of the Chinese Civil War, and enlisted in the armed forces. Like her, Zhìqiáng wanted to fight for the side of righteousness – the side of the people. And in this increasingly global and tech-driven world, he felt the best way to do so, was to join the most globally impactful branch of the world’s largest army. 

As a cadet, Zhìqiáng was selected to join a Tier 1 special operations unit. With the largest land-based missile arsenal in the world, the majority of Zhìqiáng’s early experience was securing bases in country. But increasingly, he’s been tasked with defending munitions transports and facilities globally.

An incorruptible idealist, “Zimo” is willing to sacrifice himself for the greater good – the people.

operators/zoltan_bio:
Growing up in Central Florida, Osmond “Oz” Ryan was an outsider since the day he was born. Having few family and fewer friends, Osmond frequently escaped to the online world, where he went by the handle "Oz".

A self-taught "grey-hat" hacker, Oz’s idea of fun was attempting to find exploits and weaknesses in the world’s most secure servers, and provide security fixes...for a price. This caught the interest of the Army's high brass, most notably General Shepherd. Though contracted with the US Army Cyber Command (ARCYBER), Oz would unofficially be working for Shepherd's private military group, Shadow Company. It was within this group that Oz learned to fight on both the physical and digital front lines.

The weight of the decision was magnified when, in 2022, Commander Graves found himself embroiled in a troubling "blue on blue" incident that remained under investigation. Recognizing Oz's unwavering loyalty and cyber skills, Graves entrusted him with the role of de facto leader of Shadow Company. Oz's mission was twofold: to meticulously manage the narratives surrounding the incident and to coordinate the mercenary activities necessary to ensure Shadow Company's global presence and effectiveness in ongoing conflicts. It was a difficult choice for Oz, one that challenged his sense of loyalty and duty but he delivered.
operators/zoltan_eastern_a_desc: Osmond "Oz" Ryan brings his lethal Shadow Company skills to the battlefield.

hash_32569d84cf88e67b:
“We’ve got a job to do.” - Russell Adler

Known as “America’s Monster,” Russell Adler personifies the dark, secretive nature of the CIA. Charismatic and merciless, his extensive service record stretches through anti-Soviet operations in 1960s Vietnam, clandestine CIA mind-control programs in the ‘70s, and the Perseus crisis in the mid ‘80s.

Adler’s proclivity to take missions into his own hands has led some to question his right to be in the field, but none can deny the brutal efficacy with which he achieves his mission goals. He is tapped only for the most delicate operations, and has a habit of going off grid while hunting his targets. Even those who have worked by his side for years don’t seem to truly know him, though all agree they would follow anywhere he leads.
hash_290aa943827d1190:
“Impossible? Doubt it.” - Alejo “Toro” Carasco

Alejo “Toro” Carasco, Crimson One’s loud-mouthed young hotshot, grew up in Argentina and lost his older brother during the British invasion of the Islas Malvinas. This tragedy inspired him to join the Argentine Navy. Later working as a mercenary in South and Central America, he crossed paths with the CIA during an operation in Nicaragua that led to the death of the revolutionary leader Raul Menendez’s sister, Josefina.

Eventually, Toro was brought into Crimson One by Jackson Caine, who Toro saw as a fitting replacement for the older brother he’d lost years earlier.

Driven by a need to prove himself, Toro often rubs squadmates the wrong way. Despite his temper, he is a lethal force in contact with the enemy.
hash_4d44cae01079d797:
“Speak it, write it, type it – shit, even think it – I’ll hear it.” - Tess Bailey

The daughter of a rocket scientist and a musician, Tess Bailey grew up with a  love of science and sound. At university, her graduate thesis project - an advanced audio bug that used infrared light to intercept communications, caught the attention of the NSA. They immediately put her to work designing a wide array of highly specialized remote surveillance equipment for the agency. This led to her recruitment into the CIA’s Crimson One team as an electronic surveillance and signal tracing specialist.

She knows that she’s relatively green compared to the other members of Crimson One, but Bailey is also keenly aware of her value, and refuses to let anyone diminish her worth. Optimistic and idealistic, the prospect of serving her country and protecting her people from traitorous agents like the Rogue Black Ops team excites and inspires her to do the best work of her career.

Bailey is rarely seen without a pair of headphones around her neck or an earpiece in her ear.
hash_3dd0e004e94d407c:
“Buckle up – I’m driving.” - Witold Bayan

Witold Bayan, only child of an overworked and indebted father, largely raised himself after the loss of his mother at an early age. He left his broken home as a young adult and found structure and discipline in the Army.

His penchant for fixing and upgrading vehicles led to a role in the Polish Land Forces’ 1st Mechanized Infantry, where he proved to be a capable technician. Eventually, he would leave the army, his file simply stating that he “deserted over personal disagreements with command.”

Bayan found his home in Avalon, working for the Guild. He showed a knack for moving exotic vehicles for high profile clients, and escorting the Guild’s elite on dangerous missions as their getaway driver. It was here where he developed a taste for fine wine, designer clothes, and expensive cars.

His carefree humor and confidence made him popular within Avalon circles, and when the Rogue Black Ops team came looking for recruits, the Guild gladly tasked Bayan to be their inside man.
hash_1a000c9ae8f5c3bd: Where the fog of war lays thickest on the battlefield, Omen prowls. Those unlucky enough to hear the rattle of his footsteps face a life sentence for their crimes. Each link of his ethereal chain is forged from a soul condemned to eternal imprisonment – a reminder that for those who deserve judgment, death is not the end.
hash_19550f0e26ece2a8:
Forged in hellfire and encased in a carapace of obsidian armor, Goliath is the very embodiment of pure molten fury. Shards of volcanic glass, embedded within his flesh, speak to the forces of destruction, tamed to shape his fearsome visage.

Silent as a dormant volcano, Goliath stalks the world's battlefields, leaving ruin in his wake.
hash_39a9e19a6a2482d6: Splinter, a mutant rat, is the philosophical and martial arts teacher – the Sensei – to the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. He’s a master in ninjutsu, and has taught the turtles the secrets of the ninja, the bushido code, and the warrior’s way.
hash_45fbcf1d69ee7dc8: A man of few words, Silent Bob is the thoughtful and introspective half of the duo. His rare but impactful insights often surprise those around him.
hash_6aed9600ec2630ed:
“Nothing matters more than the mission.” - Jackson Caine

Jackson Caine was always destined to be a Marine. Inspired by the sacrifices of his father, who returned from Vietnam a broken man, Caine courageously enlisted at 18. He trained alongside Troy Marshall under the tutelage of Tamira “Westpoint” Chambers, and proved to be a promising soldier. But after his brother was KIA in Lebanon, the tragedies took their toll. When the mysterious Pantheon group reached out to recruit him in the late ‘80s, he was already primed to be a perfect instrument of their will.

A natural leader, Caine expects excellence from himself and those under his command in Crimson One, and the failure of either to live up to his standards inevitably triggers fierce anger. Always on mission, always alert, Caine never lets his guard down. He’s a hard man to work with, but he’s the one every soldier wants to stand behind when things go wrong.
hash_67fbe2671ffb9c76:
“As long as I’m standing, this ain’t even close to over.” - MacKenzie Carver

Born into a military family and steeped in decades of service, Major Mackenzie Carver was a stand-out figure among those who served with him. That was before his employment with the Office of Requiem and the events surrounding the disappearance of Agent Maxis.

Now, stripped of his rank and incarcerated by the mysterious Director, Carver mourns the destruction of his distinguished military career, but refuses to slip into bitterness. Having maintained the physical and mental discipline needed to face the Dark Aether, he remains confident that one day he will escape from his prison, clear his name and reclaim his reputation and his former life.
hash_743e243b0095fd35: A seasoned veteran with a wealth of experience, Coach is the mentor figure who guides the team with his tactical expertise and calm demeanor. His ability to stay cool under pressure and make quick decisions is crucial in turning the tide of battle.
hash_5ac851541c68e293: A reckless and impulsive soldier, Beavis is known for his wild enthusiasm and tendency to charge into battle without a plan. Despite his chaotic approach, he has a knack for surviving against all odds, often leaving his enemies bewildered.
hash_2cd69cdf04138dc9: Seth Rogen's laid-back demeanor and infectious laughter make him a favorite among his squad. Known for his quick wit and strategic mind, Rogen brings a unique blend of humor and tactical expertise to the battlefield. Despite the high-stakes environment, he always finds a way to lighten the mood and boost team morale.
hash_76d0a412d1d3242: Solace shines with the radiant opulence of a lost world. The enigmatic armor that encases him whispers of ancient secrets, and the cold light of his gaze belies a vast alien intelligence. Draped in golden grandeur and crowned with a helmet of unknowable design, this resplendent warrior is fury incarnate. Wherever his gilded path takes him, glory and dread follow in equal measure.
hash_4c7c59b9bb20f68f: Underestimate her, and it will be your last dance. Trained by the Ruska Roma, Eve Macarro seeks vengeance. With an elite symphony of guns, grenades, and flamethrowers, she executes a bullet ballet with relentless precision and grace.

“Hello, my name is Klaus.” - Klaus

Klaus was constructed by Dr. Elizabeth Grey to be capable of both ranged and hand-to-hand combat. Though not intended for active duty by his creator, Klaus was nonetheless deployed in Berlin by the Director of Requiem, where he would eventually come into contact once more with Dr. Grey and her associates during the events surrounding the release of the Forsaken.

Klaus’s programmed personality exhibits many traits typical of flesh-and-blood humans, but he appears to lack any understanding of their limits or fragility.

hash_39f6197be5ec6b5f:
“Bounty’s good.” - Nocturne

Little is known of Nocturne's shadowy past, but rumors run deep among Avalon's criminal elite. Some believe his high level special forces skillset reveals military training, while others claim he is the last remaining descendant of an ancient clan of assassins. Wherever the truth lies, Nocturne is a ghost, his history as untraceable as his hit list

Cunning and ruthless, Nocturne commands the loyalty of some of Avalon’s most deadly blades. No bounty passes through the city without his knowledge, and no quarry escapes once he’s accepted a contract. Hunt’s on.
hash_577909674cf72e96:
This hothead is also the most opinionated, impulsive, and restless ninja turtle! Raphael (Raph) loves nothing more than to test himself in battle, and trains for sheer enjoyment! He’s usually the one to leap into action, and it’s nearly impossible to get him to back down. 

Raphael’s weapon choice: twin sais
hash_14c3d48d2b75578e:
“Kiss your own baby, lady.” - The Replacer

Very little is known about The Replacer and that’s just how he likes it. Birthdate, dietary restrictions, favorite subspecies of spoon-billed sandpiper? You don’t need to know. None of it matters.

What does?

Everything he knows about you. He will replace you in your life, so you can get all the Black Ops time your sick, little heart desires. He doesn’t provide a service, he gets results. 

You can rest assured when he clocks in, someone’s clocking out. Permanently.
hash_31f9a070c84d0056:
“I helped create this, and I’ll be the one to stop it.” - Dr. Elizabeth Grey

When Dr. Elizabeth Grey joined the CIA’s Office of Requiem, she couldn’t have known the turbulent world she was stepping into. Her focus on the practical applications of the exotic element Aetherium would lead to countless scientific breakthroughs, but the horrors she would experience while supporting the Requiem team would change her forever.

Now a capable, self-assured operator with a sharp scientific mind, she still holds out hope of freeing her friend, Agent Samantha Maxis, from the Dark Aether, but must first confront the forces that led to Maxis’s imprisonment - and her own.
hash_5c389e9e6f56c94e: Wearing the Chucky mask, channel the infamous doll's twisted humor and deadly precision. With Chucky’s chaotic spirit, no battlefield is safe from the reign of terror.
hash_45e7677a2e2ff03a: Reliable, incorruptible, tough-as-nails. Lives by the book. Hudson brings unrivalled knowledge and experience to any operation. His no-bullshit attitude and unflappable will in the face of danger has earned him the respect of all his peers, even those with insubordinate streaks such as Russell Adler and Frank Woods. A true CIA legend.
hash_eaaf6386cf9a367:
Michelangelo (Mikey) is the impressionist, practical joker and class clown. He soaks up all kinds of info from radio, TV, video games, etc. He’s also the most athletic but the least excited when it comes to training.

hash_1a577f48d5a22563:
“Tell the Pantheon they’re next.” - Troy Marshall

Troy Marshall is guided by a strong moral compass of his own design, which often comes into conflict with the institutional norms and the beliefs of those around him – neither of which ever stopped him from doing what he believed was right. These high standards stem from his childhood, and the promise he made to himself to be a better man than his father.

Cool and withdrawn at times, Marshall is a tactical savant and a discerning analyst. While chronically distrustful, he nevertheless harbors a humorous perspective on the harshness of the world around him, and isn’t afraid to rely on the skills of his teammates to survive the most unlikely scenarios.
hash_6225629796c56336:
Donatello (Don or Donnie) is the brain of the group. He has an awesome ability to understand how things work - anything! From computer robotics, combustion engines, rocket propulsion systems, to the light in the fridge, and more, Donnie’s a certified, self-taught genius! 

Donatello’s weapon choice: bo staff
hash_5135dd3849ee9b34: Neither wholly demon nor human, Dread emerges from the darkness of the battlefield clad in blasphemous living armor, hungry for prey. Every round fired by the grisly headhunter carries a cursed promise - torment without end.  Those who stand against his remorseless advance are not merely cut down – they are consumed.
hash_6d003fa5a05511d5:
“Here’s a tip - stay the fuck out of my way.” - Maya Aguinaldo

Maya Aguinaldo learned how to be a smuggler on the seas surrounding Southeast Asia from her roguish Filipino father, though her acerbic attitude undoubtedly came from her Australian mother. Following her father’s death, Maya and her brother Nathan operated it successfully for years, until some poor business partnership choices led to disappearances among the refugees they’d been paid to move. When her brother stepped up to investigate, he vanished, leaving Maya to set off on his trail.

Maya’s effectiveness in combat comes from long years honing her skills in infiltration, evasion, and misdirection. Her knowledge of the criminal underworld and its unorthodox tactics is a force multiplier for any ally, but her unfiltered opinions don’t make her the easiest friend to keep.
hash_19472dc55dc310d5:
“If there’s a way, I’ll find it.” - Hasib Nazir

Born to upper middle-class Pakistani parents, Hasib Nazir was expected to follow in his father’s footsteps and become a doctor. But standard schoolwork left him restless and he soon sought out extra curricular activities to occupy his persistent curiosity. In his spare time, he became fluent in several languages and discovered a love for computers, and all things electronic. This eventually led to a position within the ISI’s Joint Counter Intelligence Bureau as a cryptology and communications analyst.

Nazir’s lingual and cultural versatility allow him to blend in anywhere. He finds nuanced patterns where others just see noise, making him an invaluable intelligence asset. Though slight of build, Nazir is not one to be underestimated. His mental acuity and deadly rifle skills aside, enemies often find out the hard way that Nazir is always one step ahead of them.
hash_66c2a5fb174e0ecd: A terrible fusion of technology and raw, unfiltered rage, Vortex is violence perfected. Natural speed and strength are amplified by currents of searing power that cycle through his veins and infuse the blades on his back. Relentless and all-seeing, once Vortex sets his sights on a target, their fate is sealed.
hash_3d096a0749d67fd9:
“I don’t have time to make mistakes.” - Arak Niran

While still a rookie on the local police force’s EOD team, Niran’s quick thinking prevented the detonation of a weapons depot hidden in a densely populated residential area. After several similar showcases of skill and courage, his entrance into the Thai Army’s highly specialized Task Force 90 was fast-tracked. He rapidly garnered the respect of his fellow soldiers, but drew the ire of his commanding officers for his “problematic” opinions and independent streak.

Realizing that he had likely reached his own glass-ceiling, he left the army, and easily found a string of jobs, bouncing between defense contractors and paramilitary units until his technical expertise in explosive material mitigation and removal drew the attention of the Crimson One kill team.

Niran is known for his “sixth sense” in identifying threats that others miss. An integral part of Crimson One’s defense posture for countering improvised and marine based explosives, he is a solid, reliable presence on the battlefield.
hash_3d2ea486262d4fbb:
Leonardo (Leo) is dedicated, disciplined, and selfless. He’s a perfectionist with a strong moral sense. Because of his serious responsible nature, Leo is like the big brother of the group, Splinter’s right hand turtle, and the unofficial leader of the team. 

Leonardo’s weapon choice: twin katana swords
hash_169fa91f353f840b:
“It can't be bargained with. It can't be reasoned with. It doesn't feel pity, or remorse, or fear! And it absolutely will not stop, ever, until you are dead!”

The Cyberdyne Systems Model 101 is the ultimate infiltrator, visually indistinguishable from a human. Coated in living human tissue, its hyperalloy combat chassis is powered by hydraulic servomechanisms, granting it unparalleled strength and endurance. Skynet has sent this machine back in time to eliminate Sarah Connor, the mother of the future resistance leader. Armed with 20th-century firearms, it will stop at nothing to accomplish its mission.
hash_4fab4905f4cdc3c9:
“Spooks. Can’t trust any of us.” - Helen Park

One of MI-6’s best, Helen Park left behind a career in International Relations and joined the agency after the untimely death of her brother in a paramilitary bombing. Years of clandestine work culminated in her assignment to a classified psychological warfare program alongside the CIA’s Russell Adler. Together with Lazar Azoulay, Lawrence Sims, Alex Mason, and Frank Woods, Park’s team successfully hunted down and neutralized the international paramilitary threat code-named Perseus.

Now, years after the hunt for Perseus, Park has separated herself from Adler and used her intelligence and analytical skills to climb the ranks of MI6. Her highly competitive “Type A” personality causes some friction among her peers, but she is consistently able to find a way around conflict to secure her goals. Her commitment to the mission and her team is beyond reproach.
hash_586db57bc860ff6c: Donning the Bride of Chucky mask, embody Tiffany Valentine's charm and cunning. With Tiffany's deadly allure, become a dangerous adversary, ready to dominate the battlefield.
hash_2256223fbfd15ab2: Front Man is the leader of the Pink Guards and oversees the execution of the games. Smart, ruthless, and highly organized, he won’t let anything — or anyone — threaten the competition, making him a formidable foe.
hash_5d4dc77dc6a00e0f: The more strategic of the duo, Butt-Head prefers to take a laid-back approach to combat, often mocking his opponents before taking them down. His sarcastic wit and surprising tactical skills make him a formidable presence on the battlefield.
hash_1c153c8ecdce0bc0: Roger is a grey alien from outer space who lives with the Smith family. Known for his sarcastic, amoral, and hedonistic personality, Roger often disguises himself in various personas to interact with the world.
hash_7980e9a2e5ad65af: Squid Game guards wear jumpsuits and masks, offering complete anonymity. The lowest ranked guards have white circles on their masks. They are responsible for maintaining the island, and disposing of bodies.
hash_5388a1785351b533: Driven by revenge, the Fisherman’s stealth, strength, and single-mindedness are what makes them such a terrifying killer…that and the menacing hook in their hand.
hash_70ba3d1f31e1a186:
“I get eyes on, they’re as good as gone.” - Callum Payne

Born into a working-class family in the UK’s West Midlands, Callum Payne was an idealistic kid who enjoyed playing – and fighting – with his friends. After completing school, he joined the British Army and found purpose in military life, but a tour in the Falklands would change him.  This hopeful young man turned warrior was transformed - broken -  by an ambush that left him the sole survivor of his unit, his spotter killed right in front of him. Command’s indifference to this obvious failure of intelligence only made matters worse.

Driven by survivor's guilt, Payne went on to become one of the Royal Marines’ most decorated snipers, but the distrust of his superiors was never resolved.
hash_413e0efed63dd8f1: Stan Smith is a patriotic, and often overzealous CIA agent, known for his exaggeratedly masculine demeanor and his often misguided attempts to protect his family and country.
hash_437ed516be92f88b:
Rozlin “Roze” Helms grew up in the Colorado mountains and became one of the first women ever to graduate from the Army Ranger School. Proficient in small-unit tactics and close combat engagements, Roze had found her profession, or so she thought. It wasn’t long before she and the military machine cut ties, leaving a well-trained warrior with few choices.

Linking up with a former colleague, Roze joined The Jackals, a well-funded, non-governmental organization (NGO) focused on eliminating Al-Qatala influence in the Pan-African region. In 2020, a new opportunity came knocking at her door. It was Philip Graves, Commander of Shadow Company. The contract offered was simple: help restore order in Verdansk.

Unseen forces had different plans for Verdansk, however, and after it fell in the wake of Zakhaev’s death, Shadow Company faced its own set of challenges. Roze ended her contract in early 2022 and aligned with the KorTac group. Her skills keep her a highly sought-after operator in a post-asymmetric warfare world.
hash_3631ec37f26261d9:
“One woman’s crime is another's career.” - Sev

Born to Pakistani immigrants, a young Sevati Dumas found herself on the streets of Morocco after the untimely deaths of her parents. There, petty crime was key to her survival until she was taken in by the Guild, who transformed her into one of their most promising young assassins. Sevati’s new life in Avalon imploded when she learned that she’d been set up by her employers to take the life of her own lover.

Her worldview now shattered, Sevati has found work with Marshall and his team, fighting against the criminal factions that stole everything from her. While her street smarts and ability to blend into any crowd have proven invaluable time and time again, her own personal ambitions remain murky.
hash_37df43bfd079bc2c: As the tough and intimidating leader of the squad, Todd commands respect with his no-nonsense attitude and brute strength. He's the go-to guy for heavy firepower and isn't afraid to get his hands dirty to achieve victory.
hash_1d18a910f1d987b5: A brilliant and reliable CIA operative with a tech background and a storied Army combat record, Lawrence Sims played an instrumental role in covert ops throughout the Vietnam War, and in pursuit of the terrorist codenamed Perseus. His time in the clandestine service eventually took its toll, and Sims returned to the Army and CENTCOM. A few years later, he briefly reunited with his CIA teammates during Operation Desert Storm on a mission to capture the Pantheon scientist Matvey Gusev.
hash_9b48e2331be9f04: Vikhor Kuzmin is an ex-KGB Chemical Weapons expert who headed the Nova 6 program at Rebirth Island, until a CIA raid ended it in 1968. He reemerged as the head of the covert Soviet-based spy ring known as “Perseus”, causing widespread chaos during the Cold War. Stitch harbors a personal grudge against Russell Adler, the CIA agent that took his eye during the Rebirth operation. After the bombing of Verdansk, Stitch was wounded and taken into custody by Adler. He was remanded to a secure facility in Iceland to live out his days.
hash_550e7d196d50936a:
“The battle goes to the bold.” - Harry Stone

Respected by former SAS colleagues as a capable warfighter with an independent streak, Harry Stone is the type of soldier desired by military organizations across the globe. The mercenary career that followed his mysterious discharge from British Special Forces made him a likely recruitment candidate for Perseus and, later, the French Syndicate.

The same qualities that served Stone through his mercenary career led to a senior position on the CIA’s Crimson One kill team. Stone’s veteran mentality, broad experience, and disregard for ethical rules of engagement make him a dangerous enemy for any who oppose Crimson’s goals.
hash_528b9e73047bfdd8: Crass and demanding, the Panther Mask VIP patronizes the games and enjoys observing the participants play for their life. He revels in exploiting those he views as beneath him.
hash_528bb073047c1c6e: The Lion Mask VIP is part of a cabal of rich men from around the world who attend the games and have a front row seat to the deadly competition. Like the other VIPs, he keeps his face hidden to protect his identity.
hash_307ebea31f5b2e41:
“Secrets are leverage, everyone has them. Just gotta know where to look.” - Volta Rossi

Volta Rossi is a blood relative of Avalon’s powerful Luttazzi family, but their parents, fleeing the family’s violent legacy, moved to Italy while Volta was young. 

Growing up, Volta would excel in school, displaying a particular gift for science, psychology, and mathematics. Following graduation, they were recruited by SISMI as a case analyst, where their otherwise stellar career would be marred by a single incident; the escape of a surveilled high value target under their watch.

While the official report put the operational failure down to miscommunication, the truth was that Volta had recognized the target as one of their Luttazzi cousins, and made the tough call to allow them to escape. After rotting in a resultant punitive administrative position for a few years, a recruitment offer from the CIA offered a welcome chance for change.

Wily and street smart, Volta is a consummate professional on the battlefield. Quick reactions and even quicker wits make them popular among their teammates, who have come to appreciate their dry, acerbic commentary. They are essential to Crimson One’s surveillance and tracking operations in Avalon.
hash_7e05b8a85555cd4:
“The guilty must be punished.” - Brutus

Brutus, known as the Warden some time ago, was integral to the construction of the Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary and has been a pivotal player in the cycles of hell the prison island experienced in subsequent years.

A hulking, undead monster, Brutus commands a place of terror on the battlefield. His relentless drive to escape the life sentence set upon him during his time in Alcatraz drives him to wreak havoc and destruction on any enemy unwise enough to get in his way.
hash_354da2e56fa234d:
“I’ll never trust the system again.” - Grigori Weaver

Grigori Weaver has come a long way from his humble beginnings in the former Soviet Union. Shortly after his mother defected to the US during World War II, Weaver enlisted in the Army before being recruited to the CIA. There, he would lose his eye in an encounter with Lev Kravchenko at the Baikonur Cosmodrome, but he would go on to wear it as a badge of honor through many operations over the years. Eventually, Weaver was appointed to a role within Project Requiem, where he would play a pivotal part in the events leading to the showdown with the Forsaken.

Weaver carries the blame for much that has happened over the years. His blind trust in the Director of Requiem led to the imprisonment of his team, and Weaver’s own decisions led to the loss of Agent Maxis in the Dark Aether. He now searches for a purpose and a reason to believe  in himself again.
hash_50fa6ad5186d6190:
“Feelings don’t matter. Results do.” - Tamira “Westpoint” Chambers

Tamira Chambers earned her nickname, “Westpoint,” not from where she received her training, but by the education she gave each of her recruits in her long years as a Marine Corps Officer Specialist Instructor – recruits that included the likes of Troy Marshall and Jackson Caine. Her sterling reputation led to a Red Cell appointment planning and conducting mock assaults on US Military Bases to test defense preparedness. It was there where she met Russell Adler and followed him to the CIA.

Westpoint is old school, tough as nails, and universally respected by any who’ve served with her. She believes accountability and tough love bring out the best in her squad. Her role as a secondary authority allows her to embody her philosophy of “leading from the middle.”
hash_37f59af2d775e690: Don’t let her catch you moving in Red Light, Green Light. She’s always watching.
hash_13e5e6c24cb15ff1:
“You can’t kill me.” - Frank Woods

Sergeant Frank Woods is a self-reliant combat veteran who has fought for his country on battlefields from the streets of Berlin to the jungles of Vietnam. His infamously hostile attitude towards authority was born from his turbulent childhood and carried throughout his service in the military. 

His long combat career came to an end in a confrontation with Nicaraguan drug lord Raul Menendez that would see Woods’ close friend Alex Mason killed, and Woods crippled by a shotgun blast.

Now deskbound, Woods grapples with his new life in the post-Cold War era. No longer a field agent, he oversees his own CIA team, leveraging his skills, experience, and expertise to lead a new generation of Black Ops warriors. But that doesn’t mean he never dreams about the glory days…
hash_40d8f7405a15efe2:
“Cleared hot and going loud.” - Yara Alvarez

Yara Alvarez is a highly intelligent and resourceful combat aviator. From humble beginnings watching planes take off from the goat trails above her hometown in Puerto Rico, she set her sights on the sky and rose to the highest echelon of military aviation.

A fierce competitor with no filter, she is nonetheless an affable, supportive squadmate and the voice you want to hear over the radio when shit hits the fan. A lover of campy Silver Age comics, she keeps her favorite action hero figures glued above her instrument cluster as a reminder of the brother who taught her everything she knows.
